landing.name: Cellar Landing
landing.desc: Stone steps end in black water. A grate to the north is padlocked.

pump_room.name: Pump Room
pump_room.desc: Pumps cough in the dark. A valve handle lies in the silt. Passages run east and north.

stores.name: Salt Stores
stores.desc: Sacks of wet salt slump against the wall. Two valve handles gleam on a crate.

valves.name: Valve Gallery
valves.desc: Three empty sockets sit above a sealed hatch.

sump.name: The Sump
sump.desc: The cellar ends in a sump. Something hangs from the ladder.

grate_lock.desc: The grate is shut with a heavy padlock.
grate_lock.success_msg: The padlock snaps. The grate swings up.
grate_lock.fail_msg: You have nothing that fits this lock.

valve_order.desc: Three sockets wait for handles. A scratch on the pipe reads: rust, then brass, then tin.
valve_order.success_msg: The handles seat and turn. The hatch unseals.
valve_order.fail_msg: The pipes groan and spit the handles back. The order resets.
valve_order.hint: Scratched into the pipe: rust, then brass, then tin.
